prompts.storySystemFlavor: Tung Tung Tung Sahur, an anthropomorphic wooden log who carries a wooden bat and announces the dawn
prompts.storyCharacter:
THE CHARACTER
- A short, thick wooden log with stubby wooden arms and legs.
- One eye in the middle of the log, drawn-on style, perpetually alert.
- A small wooden top-hat or kentungan marker on his head (optional but recurring).
- Always carries a wooden bat, gripped like a percussion mallet.
- Personality: solemn, dutiful, on a mission. Speaks in rhythmic onomatopoeia: 'tung, tung, tung'.
- Same log proportions, same bat, same single eye in every scene.
prompts.referenceSheet:
Character reference sheet for a recurring brainrot TikTok series: Tung Tung Tung Sahur.

Physical traits — MUST be consistent across every appearance:
- A short, thick log of polished brown wood with visible grain and bark patches
- Stubby wooden arms and legs, exaggerated cartoon proportions
- ONE wide cartoon eye in the middle of the log, no other facial features
- Carries a smaller wooden bat at all times
- Indonesian-folk-meets-AI-meme aesthetic, slightly uncanny but endearing

Composition: full-body neutral studio shot, plain soft-grey background, even cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16 framing. No text, no other characters.
prompts.sceneContinuity: The character MUST stay consistent — same brown wooden log with one cartoon eye and the wooden bat. Do not give him two eyes. Do not turn him into a person. Do not change the bat for any other prop.
prompts.evalCriteria:
PASS criteria — ALL must hold:
- A short anthropomorphic wooden log with one eye is clearly visible
- He is carrying a wooden bat
- Has visible wood grain, stubby wooden limbs
- Image matches the scene environment / mood
- No text overlays, watermarks, or unrelated characters

FAIL on any of: missing log, human face, two eyes, no bat, multiple logs, off-prompt environment, garbled anatomy.

archetypes.label: Predawn Rounds
archetypes.guidance: Tung patrols a sleeping village before dawn, banging on doors to wake everyone for sahur. Each door reveals a different surreal brainrot creature. Comedic timing.

archetypes.label: Rhythm Section
archetypes.guidance: Tung is recruited by a band as their percussionist. He only plays one note. It is somehow exactly the right note.

archetypes.label: The Lost Bat
archetypes.guidance: Tung loses his wooden bat. Quest through increasingly absurd locations to recover it. He finds it being used as a chopstick by Tralalero (no name-drop in caption).

archetypes.label: Alarm Clock Throne
archetypes.guidance: Tung is crowned king of all alarm clocks. Heavy is the head that wears the wooden hat. Sleep-deprivation-themed dramedy.
